standard_prerequisites.name: The quoted determinant theorem and the notion of a recurring matrix
standard_prerequisites.statement: The reference environment at the top of the counted statement quotes the classical theorem on determinants of a matrix whose diagonal entries dominate their rows, in the two forms that the counted statement then re-proves for complex matrices and for the analogue obtained by rescaling the columns with a positive real vector. The chapter's own name for the second form is that of a recurring matrix.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted lemma is the chapter's own write-up of that quoted theorem, and the surrounding section uses it to show that the intersection matrix of a numerical type has rank one less than its size and that its kernel is spanned by the weight vector.

core_obligations: First claim by maximal modulus: if the matrix had zero determinant there would be a nonzero vector in its kernel; choose an index where the absolute value of the coordinate of that vector is maximal and compare the absolute value of the corresponding equation of the kernel with the row dominance hypothesis to get a strict contradiction (source lines 319-325).

Second claim by rescaling: apply the first claim to the matrix obtained by multiplying the entries in the columns by the coordinates of the positive vector, whose determinant is the product of those coordinates times the original determinant, and conclude that the original determinant is nonzero as well (source lines 326-328).

proof_roadmap.step: Maximal-modulus contradiction for the strict row-dominance form.
Reduce the weighted form to the strict form by rescaling the columns.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 Stacks Project 章 models.tex 的 Lemma lemma-recurring（源 303-316 行，证明 318-328 行）：(1) 若复方阵的每个对角元的模严格大于该行其余元的模之和，则行列式非零；(2) 若存在正实向量 m 使 |a_ii m_i| > Σ_{j≠i}|a_ij m_j| 对每个 i 成立，则行列式亦非零。关键操作不是例行核验：第一部分要取核向量中模最大的坐标 r，把 |a_rr z_r| = |Σ_{k≠r} a_rk z_k| 与两条不等式链串起来得到 |a_rr||z_r| < |a_rr||z_r| 的矛盾（319-325 行）；第二部分必须识别出「把第 j 列乘以 m_j」这一操作（行列式恰乘以 Π m_j）才能把加权形式化归为严格形式（326-328 行）。难点在于两条不等式链的衔接与「缩放即换列」这一步的确定性表述；原文位置在证明的 319-325、326-328 行。
